title: impact_shortlist
description: Post-build impact shortlist. Narrows the pre-build regression candidate pool (regression_context.json + the approved SDET_PLAN's existing_case_ref links, or the automatable subset in *_automation_plan_generator.json) down to the test cases the merged code actually impacts. The deterministic tier is pure evidence matching (shortlist_join.py) against the real change surface (change_context.json / dev_manifest.json); the fuzzy tier is judged directly by the calling agent from each candidate's title/steps against the change scope — no external scoring service. Sidecar file only — do not write a roll-up onto another team's SDET plan. Automation binding (which exact GMT/TapMind method to invoke) is out of scope for this skill.

extraction_status.description: COMPLETE only when both the deterministic join ran and every review_queue candidate was actually judged (not skipped) and extraction_notes is empty.

inputs.description: Provenance of every artefact this shortlist was derived from. Absent/stale inputs are the single biggest cause of a wrong shortlist, so they are recorded, not assumed. Pass either the SDET plan or the automation-plan-generator file (or both).

automation_plan.description: *_automation_plan_generator.json — automatable subset of the SDET plan.

change_surface.description: What the merged code actually touched — the evidence base for every deterministic reason_code below. Sourced from change_context.json (preferred), else dev_manifest.json, else the GitLab MR changes API.

changed_files.description: Repo-relative paths, deduped union across MRs. Kept for audit/traceability; this skill does not do file-level test mapping itself (that needs a real path->test index, e.g. SmartScope's Lumos mapping, out of scope here).

changed_element_ids.description: modified/removed elements are the highest-signal entries here: an existing automated test bound to that locator breaks outright.

candidate_pool_size.description: Pre-build regression candidates considered (regression_context.regression_tests + plan scenarios carrying existing_case_ref).

must_run_count.description: Deterministic-evidence tier — never demoted or trimmed by the agent.

should_run_count.description: Agent judged relevant from title/steps against the change scope, no deterministic hit.

optional_count.description: Agent judged plausibly relevant but weak; surfaced for a human to opt into.

estimated_runtime_sec.description: Only fill if a real per-test duration source is available. Never estimated.

test_id.description: BrowserStack case id as regression_context/plan reported it verbatim, e.g. C2879733.

case_number.description: Numeric case number (no prefix) — the ID-space bridge to the C<digits> ids the automation repos tag.

run_tier.description: MUST_RUN = deterministic evidence, set by shortlist_join.py, never overridden. SHOULD_RUN/OPTIONAL = the agent's own judgment call from review_queue, made by reading the candidate's title/steps against change_surface and the SDET_PLAN's scope_summary — no scoring formula.

items.description: Deterministic codes are set by shortlist_join.py (MODULE/SCREEN/LOCATOR/FLAG/API/CR_RISK/FILE_PATH_TOUCHED). AGENT_JUDGED_RELEVANT is the only code the agent itself may add, for a SHOULD_RUN/OPTIONAL pick out of review_queue — always paired with a one-sentence rationale in `explanation`. PLAN_SCENARIO_LINK is traceability only, not a reason code.

evidence.description: The concrete artefacts behind reason_codes. Every deterministic reason_code must be backed by at least one entry here — an unbacked reason code is a hallucination. AGENT_JUDGED_RELEVANT has no evidence object; its backing is `explanation`.

path_tokens.description: Repo path tokens from changed_files that matched the candidate haystack (MR-bootstrap / gitlab_mr_diff).

explanation.description: Required when a reason_code is AGENT_JUDGED_RELEVANT: the one-sentence reason the agent picked it out of review_queue. Optional otherwise.

execution_target.description: Best-effort hint from the SDET_PLAN link / regression_context.tapmind_steps presence / is_automated flag — NOT a resolved automation binding (no test_class/method_name here; that lookup is out of scope for this skill).

plan_scenario_refs.description: csv_title_association of SDET_PLAN scenarios this case is linked to (via existing_case_ref).

deselected_tests.description: Pre-build candidates deliberately NOT run, with why. Bounded to the candidate pool — never the whole corpus. This is the audit trail that makes skipping a test defensible.

reason_code.description: NO_IMPACT_SIGNAL = agent read title/steps against the change surface and found no plausible link. Set only after real judgment, never as a default.

unresolved_ids.description: Candidates that could not be joined at all (e.g. no title in either source). NEVER silently dropped — an unjoined id is an untested change, not an unimpacted one.

run_buckets.description: Roll-up of shortlisted test_ids by execution_target hint — a starting point for whoever wires the actual pipeline call, not a resolved dispatch table.

new_scenarios_to_run.description: SDET_PLAN scenarios with no existing_case_ref — brand-new coverage for this feature. Always run; impact analysis cannot deselect a test that has no execution history. Listed here so the run set is complete, not to re-plan them.
